title: Reward accounting
architecture_rule: Reward accounting must use a separately authorized reward source and canonical backing. It cannot mint through ComputeStake, seize payer escrow or fabricate Vault balance.
requirements: reward evidence authority is explicit, append-only, stake-policy and subject-kind scoped
reward source address and runtime code hash are frozen per reward-policy revision
every reward is final-evidence bound, nonzero, capped by the frozen reward policy and replay safe
reward evidence binds exact collateral position, worker/verifier identity, beneficiary and stake policy
reward evidence cannot predate the bound collateral position
historically earned reward is not confiscated solely because the collateral position later becomes inactive
reward accounting does not compute issuance or infer beneficiary/amount from relayer input
reward value is backed by a separately funded canonical Vault before credit can succeed
reward credit creates and releases an immutable native-$420 Vault obligation to the exact beneficiary
insufficient Vault free balance reverts atomically without consuming the reward or changing accounting
beneficiary and position cumulative reward accounting is deterministic and exactly-once
beneficiary claims through canonical Vault claim semantics
reward accounting does not mint, mutate collateral, debit payer escrow, alter ComputeEscrow entitlement or reuse consensus RewardController authority
security_boundaries: permissionless relay does not grant reward-selection authority
governance may publish bounded reward-source policies but cannot use the accounting contract as arbitrary Vault withdrawal authority
worker and verifier identities are verified against their exact collateral source
inactive historical positions remain identity evidence but cannot change the frozen earned reward
reward Vault solvency is enforced by canonical Vault free-balance accounting
payer escrow and consensus issuance remain separate economic domains

milestone.rationale: reward accounting introduces a new economic authority crossing reward-source policy, worker/verifier collateral identity and canonical Vault-backed claimability.
